meta.description: API design principles and decision-making. REST vs GraphQL vs tRPC selection, response formats, versioning, pagination.

copy.tagline: 选择并设计符合场景的 API 架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要决定用 REST、GraphQL 还是 tRPC，并设计响应格式与分页。
copy.tagline_en: Design and choose the right API architecture for your scenario
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to decide between REST, GraphQL, or tRPC and design response formats and pagination.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据你的需求推荐合适的 API 风格（REST、GraphQL 或 tRPC），并指导设计资源命名、响应格式、版本控制、认证和限流等。
howto.when: 当你询问如何设计 API、选择 API 风格或处理版本控制、认证等问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个用户管理的 REST API。
say.note: Claude 会给出资源命名、HTTP 方法和状态码建议。

say.text: REST 和 GraphQL 哪个更适合我的项目？
say.note: Claude 会根据你的上下文推荐合适的 API 风格。

say.text: 如何对 API 进行版本控制？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude recommends the appropriate API style (REST, GraphQL, or tRPC) based on your needs and guides resource naming, response format, versioning, authentication, and rate limiting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about API design, style selection, versioning, authentication, or related topics.

say_en.text: Design a REST API for user management.
say_en.note: Claude suggests resource naming, HTTP methods, and status codes.

say_en.text: Which is better for my project: REST or GraphQL?
say_en.note: Claude recommends based on your context.
Claude explains URI, Header, and Query versioning.
